questions.question: What does chmod 600 notes.txt allow?
options: Only the owner can read and write
The group can read and execute
questions.explanation: 6 grants read (4) plus write (2) to the owner. Both zeroes remove permissions for the group and others.

questions.question: Which signal does kill send by default?
questions.explanation: kill sends SIGTERM by default. A process can handle this signal to shut down gracefully, unlike SIGKILL.

questions.question: What does the pipe operator | normally connect?
options: A command’s standard output to the next command’s standard input
A command’s exit code to the next command’s arguments
All output streams to a log file
questions.explanation: A normal pipe connects standard output to standard input. Standard error remains separate unless explicitly redirected.
